_about: STARTUP v102 (laneSTARTUP). Read by Scripts/StartupWarm.cs (HudCfg.ReadData). The first rendered frames of the real HDRP scene cost 0.8-1.4 s (D3D12 pipeline states, volumetric fog, shadow atlas, SSGI: the same in v100 and v101, see _agents/laneSTARTUP/MANIFEST.md). This pays that cost on purpose, once, in the first frames after the scene load: Camera.main.Render() warmRenders times, behind an opaque cover, instead of in the middle of the first gameplay frames. Nothing here touches the sim: no tick, no RNG. enabled=false or -nostartupwarm = off (today's behaviour).

cover._about: Opaque IMGUI cover drawn from the scene load until the last warm render + holdFramesAfter frames have passed. Player runs only (see inHarness).

holdSim._about: true = Duel.Frozen while the warm renders run, so the fight does not start behind the cover. OFF by default: the harness frame counts and simhash must not move. Turn on only after the A/B of warmRenders alone.

inHarness._about: Proof / balance / camproof / flowproof runs: the warm renders still happen (render-only, so the first-hitch numbers in their logs are comparable with a player run); the cover and the sim hold never do.

_hitch_note: HITCH v1 (suspected): loop.log shows the 1200 ms stall at frame 4, AFTER the 2 warm renders (13+4 ms) and before cover release; cover hold 2->8 frames keeps it black through the stall. Player-only; harness has no cover.
